items.title: Backyard fireworks not allowed over long weekend in Mississauga without a permit
items.summary: The Civic Holiday long weekend is just around the corner, but that doesn’t mean Mississauga residents can celebrate with backyard fireworks without first obtaining a permit from the city.

items.title: E-bike rider from Mississauga charged with impaired driving in another Ontario city
items.summary: A Mississauga man has been charged with impaired driving after police in Guelph came across an e-bike rider who’d fallen and hurt himself while operating the motorized vehicle on Tuesday night.

items.title: Amid food security crisis Mississauga food bank seeks development charges waiver for expansion
items.summary: The proposed funding would cover the city’s share of development charges for an expansion project.

items.title: Peel Region shelter crisis deepens as intimate partner violence incidents rise
items.summary: As intimate partner violence incidents rise in Peel Region, local leaders say provincially funded emergency shelters are overburdened and hamstrung by outdated funding rules. Mississauga’s mayor and the Peel Regional Council have called for more support.

items.title: Young boy in hospital after being pulled from backyard pool in Mississauga
items.summary: A five-year-old child was rushed to the hospital after being pulled from a backyard pool late Tuesday morning in Mississauga. John Musselman reports.

items.title: Child in critical condition after being rescued from pool at Mississauga home
items.summary: Peel paramedics said a female was taken to a local hospital after police responded to a reported drowning Tuesday morning.

items.title: Discover the hidden history of Mississauga’s oldest village on free walking tours
items.summary: For many people, Streetsville is known for its restaurants, festivals and bustling main street. But tucked between the cafés and boutiques is a history stretching back more than 200 years—one that has been preserved better than almost anywhere else in Mississauga.
